Implants.name: Premium Straumann BLX Implant
Implants.description: Featured Bookimed offer. Straumann BLX is the Swiss gold-standard implant — apically tapered, fully tapered design optimized for immediate placement and immediate loading. Lifetime warranty. The implant brand of choice when patients ask for the 'best' option.

Implants.name: Biodem Dental Implant
Implants.description: Featured Bookimed offer. Biodem is a German implant brand offered with lifetime warranty. Mid-premium tier between mass-market Asian implants and Straumann.
Implants.materials: Biodem (Germany) — German manufacturing, CE marked, lifetime warranty, implant passport

Implants.name: Single Implant + Abutment + Crown (full unit)
Implants.description: Complete fixed single-tooth solution: implant + healing cap + custom abutment + zirconia or e-max crown. The most common single-tooth tourism case.
Implants.materials: Straumann/Biodem/ETK implant + Dental Direkt zirconia or Ivoclar E-max + Creation ceramic stain

Implants.name: All-on-4 (single arch)
Implants.description: Four implants supporting fixed full-arch prosthesis. Same-day temporary teeth available via 3D-guided surgical technique. Flagship dental tourism procedure.
Implants.materials: 4x Straumann/Biodem/ETK + multi-unit abutments + provisional + final zirconia/E-max bridge

Implants.name: All-on-4 (both arches)
Implants.description: Both upper and lower arches restored with All-on-4. The most common medical-tourism All-on-X case.

Implants.name: All-on-6 (single arch)
Implants.description: Six implants for stiffer, higher-force full-arch restoration.

Implants.name: All-on-6 (both arches)
Implants.description: Six implants per arch on both jaws. Top-tier full-mouth tourism restoration.

Implants.name: All-on-8 (single arch)
Implants.description: Eight implants for maximum-rigidity case (heavy bruxers, large arches).

Implants.name: Mandibular Osteotomy / Orthognathic Surgery
Implants.description: Complex jaw repositioning surgery (BSSO/Le Fort I) performed by Dr. Alessio Osmani. Hospital-grade procedure. Treats mandibular protrusion/retrusion or open bite.

Implants.name: Bone Augmentation / GBR
Implants.description: Guided bone regeneration combining particulate bone graft with collagen membrane to grow back lost bone before implant placement.

Implants.name: Sinus Lift (open / lateral window)
Implants.description: Lateral-window approach to lift sinus floor for severely atrophic posterior maxilla.

Implants.name: 3D Computer-Guided Implant Surgery
Implants.description: Pre-surgical CBCT planning + 3D-printed surgical guide + computer-controlled drill protocol. Increases precision dramatically.
Implants.materials: Vatech CBCT + planning software + 3D printed guide

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Zirconia EMAX Layered Crown
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: FEATURED Bookimed offer. Zirconia core hand-layered with Ivoclar E-max porcelain on the facial surface. The clinic's signature crown product.
Crowns & Aesthetics.materials: Dental Direkt zirconia core + Ivoclar Vivadent E-max + Creation ceramic stain — layered by Albana's lab

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Zirconia Crown (full contour)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: All-zirconia monolithic crown. Strong, biocompatible, no metal core. Most common modern crown.
Crowns & Aesthetics.materials: Dental Direkt Bio ZX2 zirconia milled in-house

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Metal-Ceramic Crown (PFM)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Porcelain fused to metal — strongest crown for posterior teeth. The traditional restoration.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: E-max Crown (lithium disilicate)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Glass-ceramic crown with superior translucency for anterior aesthetics. Industry gold standard.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Porcelain Veneer
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Thin porcelain shell bonded to enamel. Classic premium aesthetic restoration.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: E-max Veneer
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Pressed ceramic veneer with superior strength and aesthetics. Premium standard.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Composite Veneer (chairside)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Direct chairside composite veneer in single visit. Reversible.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Hollywood Smile (16 veneers)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Full-arch aesthetic transformation with 16 veneers (8 upper + 8 lower). Elixence flagship aesthetic case.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Hollywood Smile (20 veneers)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Premium full-mouth makeover with premolars (10 upper + 10 lower).

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Smile Design Consultation (DSD)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Photo protocol + digital mock-up via DSD App or SmileCloud. Used pre-veneer to align expectations.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Gingival Contouring (Gummy Smile correction)
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Diode laser reshaping of gingival margins for aesthetic harmony. Often pre-veneer.

Crowns & Aesthetics.name: Full-Mouth Aesthetic Rehabilitation
Crowns & Aesthetics.description: Combined Hollywood smile + crowns + implants for end-stage aesthetic and functional cases. Premium tourism package.
Crowns & Aesthetics.materials: Mix of veneers, zirconia/E-max crowns, possible implants

Aesthetic Whitening.name: Laser Teeth Whitening
Aesthetic Whitening.description: FEATURED service. In-office whitening session activated by laser/LED light. Results in 60-90 minutes.
Aesthetic Whitening.materials: High-concentration peroxide gel + diode laser or LED activation

Aesthetic Whitening.name: Take-Home Whitening Kit
Aesthetic Whitening.description: Custom trays + bleaching gel for 2-week home use.

Endodontics.name: Root Canal Treatment (single canal)
Endodontics.description: Removal of infected pulp from single-rooted tooth. Includes obturation.
Endodontics.materials: Frank Dental endo burs + gutta percha + sealer

Periodontics.name: Gum Disease Treatment / Periodontal Course
Periodontics.description: Multi-session program: scaling + root planing + antibiotics + maintenance. Treats periodontitis.

Periodontics.name: Gum Recession / Connective Tissue Graft
Periodontics.description: Surgical augmentation of recession defects with palatal donor tissue or Botiss Mucoderm.

Periodontics.name: Teeth Cleaning (Scaling)
Periodontics.description: FEATURED service. Professional dental cleaning with ultrasonic scaler. Standard hygiene visit.

Orthodontics.name: Invisalign (Mild / Moderate / Severe)
Orthodontics.description: Clear aligner therapy across three case complexities. Premium clear-aligner brand.

Orthodontics.name: Self-Ligating Braces
Orthodontics.description: Featured Bookimed listing. Brackets that don't require elastic ligatures — faster treatment, less friction.

Orthodontics.name: Lingual Braces
Orthodontics.description: Brackets bonded behind teeth — invisible from front. Top aesthetic ortho choice.

Oral Surgery.name: Surgical Extraction (impacted wisdom)
Oral Surgery.description: Sectioning and removal of impacted third molar.

Oral Surgery.name: Cyst Removal / Apical Surgery
Oral Surgery.description: Enucleation of jaw cyst with bone graft if needed. Featured as a doctor specialty.

Oral Surgery.name: Sedation Dentistry (IV sedation)
Oral Surgery.description: Anesthesiologist-administered IV sedation for anxious patients or long surgeries.

Tourism Add-ons.name: Airport Pickup & Drop-off
Tourism Add-ons.description: Driver service from Tirana airport to clinic and back. Included in major treatment packages.

Tourism Add-ons.name: Multilingual Coordinator
Tourism Add-ons.description: Dedicated coordinator throughout visit (IT/EN/DE/FR/AL). Backed by clinic team that speaks all languages.

Tourism Add-ons.name: Hotel Concierge / Accommodation
Tourism Add-ons.description: Pre-negotiated hotel rates near clinic. Sometimes included in package.

Diagnostics.name: Free Remote Treatment Plan
Diagnostics.description: Patient sends pano X-ray + photos remotely. Mentor/Albana review and issue treatment plan + cost band within 24-48h.

Diagnostics.name: CBCT 3D Scan
Diagnostics.description: Cone Beam CT — 3D volumetric jaw imaging. Mandatory for All-on-X and complex cases.

Warranties.name: Lifetime Implant Warranty
Warranties.description: Free implant replacement if integration fails (DMA-Elixence published guarantee).

Warranties.name: Crown 5-Year Warranty
